name: Capture
description: Screenshots, screen recordings with an editor, and text and colors from your screen.
whatsNew: Zephydian is now Zephdeck: updated for the new name.

howTo.goal: Takes screenshots of an area, a window or the whole screen, records your screen with an editor, and copies text or colours from anything on screen.
rules: Every shot is copied as soon as it's taken; the preview card can save, edit or pin it.
Record your own shortcut below to open the capture bar from anywhere.
controls: Screenshot, Record, Copy Text, Color on the capture bar
